name: skills
one_liner: Anthropic's own official collection of pre-built 'skills' that teach Claude how to do specific tasks well, free for anyone to use.
buyer: No standalone paying buyer — this is free official reference material; the real buyers are downstream of it, for whoever builds a product using it as a foundation.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company building a Claude-powered feature uses these official skills as a reliable foundation instead of writing prompts from scratch.
An agency building client AI-automation projects reuses these skills to cut build time on common tasks.
A course creator teaches 'how to build Claude agent skills' using this repo as the canonical reference.

money_ideas.idea: Not directly monetizable; the money is in building and selling a custom skill or product that uses it as a base.

steal_this: Pick an underserved niche skill not in this collection, such as filling out a specific government form, build it well, and sell it as a premium skill pack.
